findings.name: construction-project-management-accounting-system
headings: Follow the project through to its financial record.
From project context to financial explanation.
Put financial rules at the shared boundary.
One gate for ledger postingOperational modules must not bypass the accounting rules.
Derive balances from allocationsAn editable balance can drift away from recorded payments.
Calculate first, narrate secondAn LLM explanation must not decide financial numbers.

images.alt: Cedar Construction: Construction portfolio overview
Cedar Construction: Project details and operations. Budget, actual cost and phase progress share the project view, rather than living in disconnected records.
Cedar Construction: Financial reports. Reports separate revenue, expenses and receivables. The inventory valuation tile is marked Coming soon; it is not presented as delivered.
Cedar Construction: AI project risk and forecast advisor. The advisor labels its output as a trend-based estimate. Groq can explain the numbers; it does not choose the forecast or risk thresholds.
